text:
sara_finance: Heads-up: SummitCare invoice #11577 (CAD 19,100) autopay failed. Issuer returned `fraud_block`. Customer updated card but tokenization errors with BIN mismatch. They asked for alternatives (Interac e-Transfer, CAD wire, hosted pay link).
payments-bot: [AUTOPAY] invoice=11577 status=failed decline_code=fraud_block attempts=2 next_retry=2026-08-12T09:00:00Z
mike_support: Do we have another payment method on file?
leo_billing: No secondary. Portal shows original token flagged. For CAD customers we prefer local CAD settlement to avoid FX. Interac e-Transfer is fastest if customer bank supports it, but amounts >$10k may hit bank limits and some business accounts can't use Interac.
fx_treasury: We can accept CAD wire into our RBC Canada account. Preference: customer pays CAD and sends charges OUR. If their bank sends net (SHA), we may get a short-pay.
sara_finance: Can we offer a hosted one-time pay link (card/bank) that supports CAD? That might re-tokenize cleanly. Otherwise provide CAD wire instructions. Approving 48h grace while they arrange payment.
mike_support: Messaging customer: "We can send a one-time hosted pay link (24h) or provide CAD wire details. Interac e-Transfer may work if your treasury allows. Which do you prefer? We'll hold service for 48h."
customer (via mike_support): "Treasury prefers CAD wire. Can you send instructions now?"
leo_billing: Internal CAD wire template (share to customer):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Ltd
Bank: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC)
Transit: 12345
Institution: 003
Account: 001234567890
SWIFT/BIC: ROYCCAT2
Currency: CAD
Reference: INV11577-SUMMITCARE
Email confirmation (required): settlements@redwood.com
```
fx_treasury: Add note for customer copy: "Please instruct your bank to send funds OUR (pay all charges). If intermediary or correspondent fees are deducted, include the bank confirmation and trace so we can reconcile."
ops-oncall: For reconciliation: if CAD posts but auto-match fails, escalate with SWIFT trace and screenshot. Ops-oncall will manually allocate.
sara_finance: Also: once wire confirmed, block the problematic autopay token and ask customer to re-enroll a payment method if they want autopay again. Create manual reconciliation ticket.
payments-bot: [TICKET] FIN-7999 created: SummitCare manual CAD wire for INV-11577.
mike_support: Sending wire details to customer now.
customer (via mike_support): "Bank is initiating CAD wire now, expect confirmation email in ~90 minutes." :thumbsup:
leo_billing: When confirmation arrives, request screenshot with SWIFT trace/FedRef and payer legal name exactly as registered. We'll apply immediately on receipt.
sara_finance: Thanks team 44d keep FIN-7999 updated. Close thread when ledger shows cleared"
